name: Release risk gate
description: Turn a deployment snapshot into an escalation decision and an ordered risk score.

observations: Retry traffic is 11% of checkout volume
On-call coverage begins 45 minutes after the proposed release window

ship_decision.instructions: Choose the release disposition supported by the evidence.

criteria.ship: Proceed in the planned window without added controls
criteria.ship_with_guardrail: Proceed only with a canary, rollback threshold, and active owner
criteria.hold: Do not release until missing evidence or unacceptable risk is resolved

human_review_needed.instructions: A human release owner should review this deployment before it proceeds.

criteria.true: The evidence contains a material unresolved risk or missing release control.
criteria.false: The evidence is complete and the remaining risk is routine.

operational_risk.instructions: Rate the operational risk of releasing in the proposed window.
criteria: Low: routine change with complete evidence and immediate ownership
Moderate: bounded concern with a proven mitigation
High: material uncertainty or customer impact is plausible
Critical: likely severe impact or no safe rollback path
